🚀 Big Launches.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Replit launches a Free Mode powered by GPT‑5.6 Luna, letting anyone build and run code without token limits. Why it matters: lowers the barrier for hands‑on AI‑assisted development, a trend hiring teams are watching.

🚀 Big Launches.title: LFM2.5 Q4_0 Checkpoints from Quantization-Aware Distillation
🚀 Big Launches.summary: Hugging Face releases LFM2.5 Q4_0 model checkpoints generated via Quantization‑Aware Distillation, offering high accuracy at a fraction of the size. Why it matters: showcases state‑of‑the‑art model compression for edge deployment.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: 5 new ways to level up your learning with Search
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: Google AI Blog rolls out free study‑tool integrations (e.g., Add Notebook, Ask Google) to help students research and organize information faster. Why it matters: provides free, searchable knowledge bases useful for project prototyping.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: Quantization‑Aware Distillation (QAD) for efficient models
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: The QAD technique blends quantization and knowledge distillation to produce compact, high‑performing models—an increasingly common interview topic in MLOps and Edge AI. Why it matters: demonstrates a practical path to deploy large models on limited hardware.

🎯 Interview Edge.title: GPT‑5.6 Luna Free Mode illustrates agentic AI for coding
🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Replit’s free‑mode lets users issue natural‑language prompts that generate, run, and debug code autonomously, a concrete example of agentic AI. Why it matters: interviewers often probe candidates on building or evaluating such autonomous agents.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: OpenAI reaffirms a zero‑data‑retention policy for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing to keep data private while ensuring safety. Why it matters: privacy guarantees are becoming a differentiator in enterprise AI contracts.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: OpenAI seeks to one‑up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: OpenAI announces tighter privacy controls to outpace Anthropic, signaling a competitive race on data‑security features for enterprise users. Why it matters: showcases how regulatory pressure is shaping product roadmaps.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn't
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: A TechCrunch analysis notes growing consumer wariness toward ubiquitous AI, highlighting the gap between hype and public trust. Why it matters: ethical and societal concerns are increasingly part of interview discussions.

tool_of_day.title: Hugging Face Quantization‑Aware Distillation (QAD) library
tool_of_day.summary: A free, open‑source library that lets you apply QAD to compress large language models, perfect for student projects and interview demos.

hot_take: Today's mix of privacy‑first launches and ultra‑efficient model tricks signals that the next wave of AI hiring will reward engineers who can build responsible, edge‑ready solutions.
